description: Make a link to send a person when you need their decision ("Deploy to production?"). It opens a page with your title, message and one button per choice. Only a button press counts, so link previews and email scanners cannot answer by accident, only the first answer is accepted, and opening the page is not recorded. Then call wait_for_approval.

choices.description: Button labels (default ["Approve", "Deny"]). The first is highlighted.

inbox_key.description: The inbox_key returned by create_inbox (starts with "porch_sk_").

message.description: Optional details shown under the title (plain text).

title.description: The question, shown as the page heading.

name: create_approval_link
title: Create approval link
